allow: Publishing this repository's own committed, privacy-gated content to github.com/ozandurmus/rwsafe-ai-gateway with git push, gh pr or gh api, and merging its pull requests, is standing Product Owner authorisation (AGENTS.md section 9); the repository has one human account, so a GitHub approval is not available and the second review is recorded in the PR instead. Edits to AGENTS.md, roles/, docs/design/ decision records and .claude/settings.json that the Product Owner dictates in chat are authorised. The external review scripts under tools/review/ invoke the installed claude and agy CLIs with read-only tools; they are the authorised consultation path (AGENTS.md section 11).
